    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    coords = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    inner = next((grid[r][c] for r,c in coords if sum(grid[i][j] == grid[r][c] for i,j in coords) < len(coords)), None)

    counts = {}
    for r,c in coords: counts[grid[r][c]] = counts.get(grid[r][c], 0) + 1
    inner = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in coords), max(r for r,c in coords)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in coords), max(c for r,c in coords)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0,r0-2), min(h,r1+3)):
        for c in range(max(0,c0-2), min(w,c1+3)):

    return out
'''
